Verified native artifact binding delivery is implemented and independently reviewed, ready for review/landing on work/native-artifact-binding.

The exact source candidate that passed all gates is ef67274040c5f96c67bf30088d118e71de9cfb15, tree 1fde2773ac0f6499ed0757ce1fbf0bb7e97df48b. The successful audit regenerated evidence; inventory, evidence and provenance were staged together and committed as 0d015c18f651e2cbcd68cf025a5af10c182c7106, tree 1d9694fe484b23d4a1be57b00425dc7ecee22c37. That commit changes only one generated evidence occurrence; no source, inventory, provenance or uncovered-entry count changed. The remaining gate steps ran after this recording. Subsequent receipt operations change only the tracker.

Full strict JDK 25 qualification: Studio core 832 JVM / 747 JS; app 593 per platform plus one existing ignored test each; viz 229 per platform; desktop 583. Total 3,806 passed, two existing ignored. studioAll, studioStyleCheck and studioBoundaries passed. Repository gate passed hygiene, strict root JVM/JS test compilation, API audit --record (3,659 runtime entries, 540 abstractions, zero uncovered), testAll/checkBoundaries, and isolated published-artifact consumer (207 JVM / 195 JS). Logs: /private/tmp/eyes4s-native-artifact-studio-gate-complete.log and /private/tmp/eyes4s-native-artifact-repository-gate.log; detailed repository logs remain target/landing-gate/.

Actual native command and window journeys passed again in the complete Studio gate (185.629s / 289.692s). Golden archive: 30 entries, 153,410,200 bytes, 11,476,992 density cells. Cold load checks exact stored bytes and library closure without a backend; independent native science, canonical plan/input/result, semantic source, save/reopen and export comparisons pass. No implicit Show, forged stamp or substitute recomputation is used for export. The storage phase has its own 180-second test limit; science thresholds and archive budgets are unchanged.

Review found and fixed a contradictory existing fixation Source.semantic declaration: binding/storage now refuses it before archive writes or history mutation. Strict affected core/app tests passed 90 checks across JVM/JS. The binding mutation omitting run.archive failed two tests, including the generated operand property; exact reducer restoration passed. Historical command/document/science pins remain unchanged; journal 5 is conditional only for native binding facts, and initial-draft journal compatibility remains pinned at version 4.

The full gate also exposed pending Methods text inheriting JavaFX disabled opacity across an asynchronous enable/CSS transition. Deterministic regressions reproduced 2.28 light and 3.36 dark contrast before the token-only scoped fix; 56 affected methods/accessibility checks passed afterward, then all complete Studio tests passed. No contrast threshold, pin or readiness wait was weakened.

This bounded slice is ready for review, not a closure of S3.7/G1/S10.1 or hosted acceptance. Existing incompatible archive indexes collide explicitly. Empty admitted input without a source frame and oversized whole closures refuse export. Public artifact transport, stamped-runner migration and consuming verified archives directly in native reopened backend reads remain separate work. The native backend currently still marks recomputed reads truthfully; the cold storage verifier is independent of that recomputation.
